subject: Observability add-ons — retention, tracing & dashboard pricing
messages:

Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarification: observability add-ons pricing & retention options

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the low-latency inference but I need a clear cost model for the observability add-ons before I can move this to procurement. Specifically can you confirm:

- Retention tiers for traces/metrics/logs and how usage is measured (GB-month, events, or token-equivalent).
- Pricing for advanced dashboards (is it per seat, per dashboard, or flat tier?).
- Tracing sampling and whether deeper trace retention (full-span storage) incurs a multiplier.
- SLA crediting: what happens if we miss latency/ingestion SLOs and how credits appear on invoices.

Procurement also asked about discounts for committed usage (6 vs 12 months) and whether there are bundled bundle options for telemetry + tracing + dashboards. We're evaluating a shortlist and pricing clarity will determine whether Redwood gets a formal bid.

Can you send a concise options doc and an initial quote? If possible, procurement would like a 30–45 minute call this week.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Health

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: observability add-ons pricing & retention options

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a short options packet and an SLA credits table to get the conversation started (see attachments). Key points up front:

- Retention: we measure telemetry as GB-month for traces/logs and as datapoints for metrics. We include 7 days of telemetry in base; 30/90/365-day tiers are available as add-ons.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards are licensed as a managed tier (flat monthly fee that covers up to a set number of dashboards + seats) — details in the PDF.
- Tracing: deep-span/full payload retention is a separate multiplier (typically 2.5x for full-span storage) — can be tiered by service.
- SLA credits: formal schedule in the spreadsheet; credits apply as a percentage against the monthly observability add-on invoice.

I can carve time for a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon or Thursday AM. Let me know what works and I’ll bring Marissa (commercial) and Ben (solutions) for pricing and technical detail.

Attachments: Observability_Pricing_Options_v1.pdf (summary), SLA_Credits_Table.xlsx (credit schedule)

Best,

Subject: Re: Clarification: observability add-ons pricing & retention options

Olivia — quick technical clarifications to help model costs:

- Units: traces/logs = GB ingested * retention_days = GB-month. Metrics = metric datapoints stored * retention_days.
- Sampling: default trace collection uses adaptive sampling; you can opt-in to full-span capture for specific services. Full-span storage increases storage costs (~2.5x) and query cost due to larger index sizes.
- Dashboard economics: advanced dashboards include prebuilt widgets, cross-service joins, and alerting. We price that as a managed tier (example: $500/month for up to 10 dashboards + 5 seats) — additional dashboards add ~$40/dashboard/month.
- Cost controls: you can configure per-service retention and sampling rules (recommended) to keep production traffic within budget.

If you share a rough ingestion profile (avg GB/day, top 3 services), I can run an estimated cost model and attach a short notes file with assumptions.

Attachment: observability_pricing_notes.txt (assumptions + sample calc)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Commercial: Observability bundle proposal for Acme Health (draft)

Olivia — following the internal call, here is a draft commercial structure you can share with procurement. Numbers below are indicative and we can finalize with a signed commitment.

Proposal (monthly pricing examples):
- Base Observability (includes 7-day retention): included in Dedicated plan.
- Traces (30-day retention): $0.03 / GB-month
- Traces (90-day retention): $0.02 / GB-month
- Traces (365-day retention): $0.015 / GB-month
- Full-span (deep) retention multiplier: x2.5 on the selected tier
- Advanced Dashboards managed tier: $600 / month (up to 12 dashboards + 8 seats). Extra dashboards $35/dashboard/month.

Volume discounts on telemetry add-ons (applies to trace GB-months only):
- 0–5 TB/mo: list price
- 5–20 TB/mo: 8% discount
- 20+ TB/mo: 15% discount

Commit discounts (applies to combined observability add-ons when a term is selected):
- 6 months: 7% off add-on line items
- 12 months: 12% off add-on line items

Commercial flexibility: if Acme commits to a 12-month annualized minimum (workloads + telemetry), we can include 1 month of 90-day retention extension (applies first quarter) and increase the dashboards cap by 20% for the first 3 months at no charge. For a 6-month pilot, we can offer a 7% committed discount.

Attached: Quote_ACME_Observability_2026-09-04.pdf (draft quote with example consumption assumptions).

Let me know procurement questions and whether we should prepare a redline-friendly SOW.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
